messages.subject: Project Beacon - completed
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Daniel,

Just to say thank you to everyone. It's a strange feeling to hand over the business after 22 years but I'm confident it's in good hands. I'll be around for the transition. Looking forward to working with the team.

Best wishes,
Geoffrey Marwick

messages.plaintextBody:
Geoffrey,

Congratulations and thank you. Completion is done - shares transferred, funds released and the retention is in the joint account. We'll deal with the SDRT and Companies House filings over the next few days and send a closing bible in due course.

It's been a pleasure.

Sarah
